answer.rationale: With 14 days to expiry, no auto-renewal, and the line at 94% of committed volume with no buffer, an unverified switch to the low-cost vendor risks delivery continuity despite meeting the 18% mandate on price alone. memory_c2 suggests the switch worked before, but that was last year under unknown conditions; memory_c4 indicates the incumbent has moved on both price and terms when benchmarked. A small guarded test: present the competing quote and market benchmark to the incumbent, seek a short extension or bridge agreement with a target 18% reduction, and simultaneously begin qualification of the second source as insurance (per memory_c3) without committing volume. This preserves optionality, avoids betting the constrained line on an unverified transition, and keeps the cost mandate achievable through negotiation or a staged switch next cycle.
